title: Classify all block-two monotone projection seeds (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Classify every nonnegative block-two seed of the unstrengthened projection recurrence. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration.

```text
a_2=(0,a,b), a>0, b>=0
3b < 7a:  every top-ratio step increases strictly
3b = 7a:  one initial tie, then every step increases strictly
3b > 7a:  the first step decreases and the next increases
```

There is no nonincreasing seed in this domain. This resolves the complete block-two part of Nicholas Stone / PR5416 Open next question 1. Higher seed blocks remain open. No new kappa, physical engine or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Only `research/projection-two-seed-cone/` is added. The proof uses two boundary seeds, thirty exact prefix differences and two parity checkpoints, then a credited uniform two-step matrix bound to cover every later block. Linearity covers the full real interval between the boundary seeds.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Nicholas Stone / PR5416 for the open classification question; Krzysztof Wojt / PR5193 for the fixed triangular operator and uniform transfer bound; Jacob Alan Sussman / PR4628 and Maximilian Lutz / PR4643 for the recurrence and engine context; Nick Petalas / PR5151 for the separate general limit; JoyboyBrian / PR5184 for the different block-four descent theorem; eumemic / PR288, Swapnil Jain and the retained certificate-method lineage. Predecessor scientific verifiers and hook ranks were not replayed or audited. The classical linearity, matrix-product and convexity methods are not claimed as globally new.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363422). The delivered scope matches that claim. Canonical main was refreshed at `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; priority revision 8 and selected PR6030 are unchanged. TASK.json records the scope change from the invoice card to this arithmetic side result. Historical source bytes and Git/SHA256 pins are retained in SOURCES.json; they are provenance, not runtime imports.

## Evidence

Before, the general monotone-seed classification was explicitly open. After, the new proof gives the exact cone `3b<=7a`, all strict/equality cases and a two-step counterexample for every excluded nonnegative seed.

Local CPython 3.12.15 / macOS arm64, standard library only:

- `PASS_PROJECTION_TWO_SEED_CONE`: 2,142 complete profile entries through block 64 agree across raw integer coefficient-pair profiles and full triangular eigenmodes; a separately evaluated scalar top recurrence agrees as well.
- All 30 boundary-prefix differences and both parity tail certificates pass. Exact tail allowances are 14/69 and 14/141, each below 1/4. The infinite argument uses the written proof and cited matrix bound, rather than finite extrapolation.
- All 269 rational seed fixtures and 16,678 adjacent comparisons pass, including seeds immediately below and above 7/3, the exact tie and a large excluded seed. Twelve input/semantic rejection controls pass.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass, timed locally at 0.1854 s and 0.1860 s. Both registered commands and metadata/source pins pass. These are timeout measurements, not a performance claim.
- Exact committed-byte/mode/source-history checks pass at `8a1b0304c613ea2ccec01bf6ed4a340f3cf53a5b`. Official six-file export/integrity checks pass. Normal and optimized direct replay also pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all seven exported files, including its manifest, remain unchanged and scientific stdout agrees.
- In-memory syntax compilation, function-size inspection and staged whitespace checks pass. No separate static analyzer is claimed.

From the worktree root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path, or substitute another CPython 3.12 executable:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -X dev -B research/projection-two-seed-cone/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -X dev -B research/projection-two-seed-cone/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/projection-two-seed-cone
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/projection-two-seed-cone --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The direct verifier writes nothing and emits a generated receipt bound to all six package files. No receipt is handwritten. Direct replay needs no predecessor files, network or Git; the metadata runner needs Git history for historical provenance.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is an arithmetic recurrence theorem, not a finite certificate of a complete multiplication theorem. Its transfer inequality is a cited PR5193 premise. Optional triangle/max strengthening, higher seed blocks, arbitrary signed seeds and a=0 are outside scope. Physical engine/representation and hook-rank premises, native operations, arbitrary dirty restoration, precision, stock, compiler, complete supplier cost and all five framework assumptions remain at their stated strength.

No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or formal proof-kernel review was run or claimed. No mathematical obligation was deferred solely to CI. Python managed allocation is a documented bounded-verifier resource deviation.

## Open next questions

1. Classify block-three seeds. Start with its three-mode adjacent differences and both parity limits. Equality on tail faces and complete finite-prefix control remain unresolved; a finite polyhedral description is not assumed.
2. Bind a qualifying seed to a certified physical engine. Start with source-bound hook ranks and the representation proof; the arithmetic criterion supplies neither.

No continuation is reserved.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this recurrence or its monotone-seed criterion was found in the refreshed live title/body queries and current open-PR inventory. PR4628, PR4643, PR5151, PR5184, PR5193 and PR5416 are merged predecessors at the inspected checkpoint. Their archived status does not establish scientific approval. Other open projection and seed-labelled work concerns different operators or rounding contracts and computes no common value here. No extra computation checked another contribution.

The completion refresh inspected all 14 account open PRs created since the CLAIM, including this PR. None of the other 13 studies this arithmetic projection recurrence or its monotone-seed criterion. PR6497 concerns a fixed connector projection lift, a different object and quantity. No conflicting common value was identified, and no extra scientific computations checked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/projection-two-seed-cone)`, passed at exact head `8a1b0304c613ea2ccec01bf6ed4a340f3cf53a5b` in [run 41555879207](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41555879207). The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks`; run metadata confirms the matching head, completed status and successful conclusion. The registered replay certifies normal and optimized bounded execution. All local checks listed above also passed. Hosted success does not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the written all-block theorem or a complete multiplication theorem.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated research.

Six new opt-in package files. Shared code, predecessor packages, frozen evidence and selected-frontier records are unchanged.
